# stalwart_archived_item (Data Source)

Represents an archived item that can be restored.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object. Set either `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Name of the archived file

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) The account to which the archived item belongs
- `archived_at` (String) Timestamp when the item was archived
- `archived_until` (String) Timestamp until which the archived item will be deleted permanently if not restored
- `blob_id` (String) Identifier of the archived blob
- `content` (String) Content of the archived sieve script
- `created_at` (String) Creation date of the archived file
- `from` (String) Sender of the archived email message
- `received_at` (String) Received date of the archived email message
- `size` (Number) Size of the archived email message
- `start_time` (String) Start time of the archived calendar event
- `status` (String) Current status of the archived item
- `subject` (String) Subject of the archived email message
- `title` (String) Title of the archived calendar event
- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.
